method_revision: Updated before final estimates after a preliminary implementation audit exposed severe scale instability when the AIANNH exposure was nearly collinear with supplied tribal_pct. The primary effect is region-adjusted correlation; provided-control residual screens use bounded partial correlation, and exact/non-identifiable exposure residuals are not estimable. No exposure or outcome selection changed.

cdc_svi_2022.definition: CDC/ATSDR overall social vulnerability percentile rank

usda_ruca_2020.definition: USDA primary rural-urban commuting-area code; numeric code treated as ordinal, not interval

census_pdb_2026_broadband.definition: PDB percent of households with no internet; convert percent points to fraction

census_aiannh_2020_overlap.definition: fraction of each study tract polygon overlapping the dissolved 2020 Census AIANNH polygon union; tract overlay uses 2024 TIGER tract geometry with matching 2020 tract GEOIDs

primary_effect: region-adjusted partial correlation between the external exposure and frozen proxy outcome; county-cluster bootstrap 95% CI; descriptive, not causal or a target estimate
residual_screen: secondary partial correlation after residualizing both exposure and outcome on region fixed effects plus provided pct_urban, svi_overall, ruca_primary and tribal_pct; near-duplicate exposures are reported not estimable
holdout_metric: compare baseline-control OOF R2 with external-layer-added OOF R2 on identical held-out tracts; five deterministic folds grouped by state+county, with no test-county rows used for fitting
holdout_replication: report region-specific region-adjusted correlation signs and count regions matching pooled direction; county-grouped OOF delta-R2 is the predictive replication metric
near_collinearity_rule: if residual external-exposure SD after provided controls is below 1e-10 times raw exposure SD, report conditional residual effect and CI as not estimable, set p=1 for the fixed 28-test FDR family, and retain region-adjusted effect and county holdout delta-R2

uncertainty.method: county cluster bootstrap, resampling counties with replacement within each of the four regions and retaining every tract row in a sampled county

multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across all 28 layer-by-outcome conditional residual-screen tests; two-sided add-one sign-frequency from county-cluster bootstrap
missingness: complete case for selected exposure, outcome and provided controls; report exact analytic N; do not impute absent exposure data
candidate_policy: read only frozen candidate CSVs; never modify or use external fields in any candidate build/upload
release_note: source terms/licensing statements are recorded from the acquisition manifest; terms marked unverified remain explicitly unverified
